summary: Master supplier evaluation techniques with our comprehensive course. Improve your performance measurement skills and optimize supplier relationships today.
lede: Supplier performance measurement and evaluation gives procurement and supply chain professionals a structured way to assess vendor results. It supports comparing supplier performance with organizational needs and identifying where improvement is required. The course covers designing KPIs, building weighted supplier scorecards, assessing supplier risks and developing corrective action plans.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals who manage external partnerships and are responsible for the integrity of the corporate supply chain.
audience: Supplier Quality Engineers focused on technical compliance
modules: Metric Design and the SCOR Model
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of procurement processes and at least one year of experience in a supply chain, sourcing, or vendor management role. No prior experience with advanced statistical software is required, but a working knowledge of Microsoft Excel for data manipulation is highly recommended.
